objective: For arbitrary reuse of hidden padding and at most one positive middle name shared by different occurrences, establish an exact decision algorithm with its work bound and assignment construction.
status: Proved: Ordinary satisfiability with arbitrary shared existential pads and at most one repeated positive middle name has a witness-producing linear indexed algorithm. A two-stage instance becomes contradictory only when the middle pair and pad pair are both identified.
title: A complete regrouping when one middle name is reused
